2893-3875-4136-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2440-3581-7109-8296.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-7109-8296.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

2292-2317-4826-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

232-678-6495.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat.
232-678-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

783-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2324-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2324-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2324-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Proper Burial and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1939-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2403-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1818-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1818-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

789-2921-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-2921-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-3490-4050-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
803-3490-4050-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Arcane Adaptation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1362-1479-7201.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1812-2440-6737-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Barret triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
1812-2440-6737-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

240-2079-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

679-1742-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-1742-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-3121-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1651-3875-4426-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-4426-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-4426-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1315-2034-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-2034-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
1315-2034-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1399-1606-1680-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

585-4508-5184-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Anointer Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1086-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

2073-6522-6797.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2921-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-6701--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1548-6426.easyPrerequisites: Sandstorm Crasher does not have summoning sickness.
1548-6426.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1548-6426.description:
Declare Port Razer and Sandstorm Crasher as attackers, choosing to exert Sandstorm Crasher as it attacks.
Sandstorm Crasher triggers, creating a token copy of Port Razer that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering Port Razer, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1322-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1651-2034-2797-3129.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-3175-4349.notablePrerequisites:
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
You have the highest life total.
670-1619-2719-3175-4349.description:
Cast Sun Titan by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it, Radiant Solar and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fell Stinger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fell Stinger enters the battlefield, its exploit ability, Radiant Solar and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Fell Stinger trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Fell Stinger's second ability triggers, causing target player to draw 2 cards and lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Trapped Entry" room of Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to discard a card or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Sun Titan and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land, or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a legendary 4/4 The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1013-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Famished Paladin.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
1013-3957.description:
Give Famished Paladin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2567-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
2567-4050-5003.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, creating a number of 0/1 green Plant creature tokens equal to the number of lands you control.
Sacrifice 3 Plant tokens to Phyrexian Altar adding three mana in any combination of colors.
Sacrifice Avenger of Zendikar to Phyrexian Altar to add a mana of any color.
Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Pay for the Nim Deathmantle trigger, returning Avenger of Zendikar to the battlefield with Nim Deathmantle attached to it.
Repeat steps 2-6.

2130-3041-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion.
When it enters the battlefield, it does near infinite damage to you and to Coalhauler Swine, and you gain life equal to the damage dealt.
Coulhauler Swine deals that much damage to each player, gaining you that much life.

803-3581-4302.notablePrerequisites:
An additional Spirit on the battlefield.
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3581-4302.description:
Sacrifice a Spirit to Kykar's ability, gaining {R}.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit token.
When the token ETB, Bishop of Wings triggers again, gaining you 4 life.
Repeat.
